summary:
Our project, FLAME IN FREEFALL, is an advanced research platform that uses super intelligent AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools to explore how fire behaves in microgravity. It helps users access, understand, summarise and compare scientific research related to space combustion and spacecraft fire safety. The platform includes AEROFLAME, a scientific research dashboard, and IGNIS, an AI powered assistant that helps users explore complex research and scientific information. It also features an interactive space simulation where users can explore microgravity and learn about fire safety through realistic scientific scenarios.

Our goal is to combine AI, scientific research and interactive technology to create a platform that supports researchers, engineers and professors in understanding combustion in space and contributes to making future space missions safer.
details:
FLAME IN FREEFALL is an AI powered scientific research platform focused on understanding combustion and fire safety in microgravity. The project explores how flames behave differently in space compared to Earth and how this research can contribute to safer spacecraft and future human space exploration.

The platform combines scientific research, artificial intelligence, interactive simulations, and data exploration in one environment. Its main research system, AEROFLAME, helps users explore, organize, understand, summarize, and compare microgravity combustion research. It also includes IGNIS, an AI powered assistant designed to help users understand scientific concepts and navigate research information. The Simulation Experience provides an interactive space environment where users can explore microgravity concepts and observe how different conditions influence flame behaviour.

The project aims to make complex scientific research more accessible, organized, and easier to understand while supporting further exploration of spacecraft fire safety. It is designed for researchers, aerospace engineers, professors, and university students.

The platform was developed using AI assisted development tools, large language models, and modern web technologies. These tools supported the development of the interface, AI assistant, research features, and interactive experiences. The project combines scientific accuracy with an innovative digital experience to connect research, technology, and space exploration.
dataRefs: A Researchers Guide to International Space Station Combustion Science
